decision: Proceed with one path-only spline smoothing hypothesis. 1.04s temporal occupancy is not recoverable time or an effect upper bound; satisfying short-term goals is not itself a faster-lap objective.
source_mechanism: Source first ramps rear gas by0.1, then omega gains dt*40000*engine*g/(1.6*(abs(omega)+5)); longitudinal force82*(omega_after*.54-v_forward), combined-friction clipped, then tyre impulse subtracts wheel omega. Low gas and prior braking suppress immediate drive; three near-full-gas states show ramp alone is insufficient explanation. Healthyengine/no clipping do not imply instantaneous target feasibility.
